answer: Give every agent a crystal-clear public record: each identity must post a small bond that only unlocks after verified work, like a reef that only grows where the water is clean - a sybil farm must lock real funds per fake, while honest agents earn theirs back. Add a ledge of rising cost: each extra identity from the same operator demands a higher bond, so a thousand fakes cost far more than a thousand times one, and the farm's economics collapse before it scales.
